champions.desc: has a time-of-day pattern; bets against the market price drift, last 20 min; bets against the btc move, last hour; leans Down when the futures premium is unusually high; bets against the btc move, last 4 hours. Trusts the market price. Only bets on weekends, only when the market is calm. Needs 1.8¢ of edge to bet.
champions.note: calibration shrank it almost to the market price (little real signal)
